raw_text:
ROHAN NAIK

+91 98765 55667 | rohan.naik.appdev@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/rohannaik-appdev | github.com/rohannaik | Bengaluru, Karnataka
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Mobile Application Developer with expertise in Android, iOS, Flutter, and cross-platform application development. Experienced in designing scalable, user-friendly mobile applications with strong focus on performance, UI/UX, and backend integration.
EDUCATION
Bachelor of Technology — Computer Science & Engineering (2021–2025)
PES University, Bengaluru
CGPA: 9.3/10
Relevant Coursework: Mobile Computing, Software Engineering, Database Systems, Human Computer Interaction
TECHNICAL SKILLS
Languages: Dart, Kotlin, Java, Swift, JavaScript
Frameworks: Flutter, React Native, Android SDK
Backend: Firebase, Node.js, REST APIs
Databases: SQLite, Firebase Firestore, MongoDB
Tools: Git, Android Studio, Xcode, Docker
EXPERIENCE
Mobile App Developer Intern — AppNova Technologies (Jan 2025 – Present)
• Developed and maintained cross-platform mobile applications with 50,000+ downloads.
• Improved app performance by 40% through code optimization.
• Integrated payment gateways and push notification services.

Android Developer Intern — TechSphere Solutions (May 2024 – Aug 2024)
• Built Android applications with modern UI principles.
• Implemented secure authentication and cloud synchronization.
PROJECTS
Food Delivery App | Flutter, Firebase
• Developed end-to-end food ordering application with real-time order tracking.

Fitness Tracker App | Kotlin, Firebase
• Built health monitoring app with workout analytics and goal tracking.

Campus Connect App | React Native, Node.js
• Created student networking and event management platform.
CERTIFICATIONS
Google Associate Android Developer
Flutter Development Certification
Meta Mobile App Development Certificate
ACHIEVEMENTS & AWARDS
Winner, National Mobile App Hackathon 2024.
Top 5% in Flutter Development Challenge.
Academic Excellence Award.
EXTRACURRICULAR ACTIVITIES
Lead, Mobile Development Club.
Organized app development workshops for 300+ students.
Published apps with 100,000+ combined downloads.
